bluf: Moburst is a New York mobile first, full service growth agency (founded 2013) selling app marketing, ASO, SEO, AEO, PR, influencer, media buying and product development, with no lead line but six core lines at score 2. It pushes AI search through its AnswerBurst AEO practice and its own GEO ads, and publishes at pace: 480 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days. The record points it at AI visibility and creator work on top of app growth. A rival should know its house passes 5 of 5 say and do tests, 11 of 15 clients have described work, and its weak point is proof: no audited AI visibility product shows.
doing:
The positioning line, a mobile first, full service growth agency that builds AI powered growth engines to make startups and enterprises category leaders, decodes as an app growth shop widened into every acquisition channel, with the AI framing sold on top. The headline claim is named results, Samsung +1400%, Reddit +90% organic growth, Uber +27%, quoted as claims and repeated in its LinkedIn ads.

The sold mix has no lead line; six core lines score 2. AI Search / GEO: a dedicated AEO and GEO service page, an AEO blog category, the AnswerBurst practice launch post and a homepage section on ranking in all LLMs. Content & Digital PR: a PR service with media relations and publications, and LinkedIn ads pushing earned media. Creator & Influencer: influencer, Creator Network and UGC services with case studies for Miro, Truecaller, Bedsure and PlugSports. Paid Social: media buying pitched as social campaigns for mobile user acquisition, with Shopkick TikTok and PreVue social cases. SEO: an Organic Awareness bundle of SEO and ASO with cases for Uber, Reddit, Calm and Discovery. Web & Product: a Product & Dev unit covering web, app and UI/UX, with a 14-month AIG website rebuild and a NewDay USA redesign. Six lines score 1, paid search, CRO and data among them; B2B, local and retail media score 0. Proprietary: Growth Labs and AnswerBurst. The record lists no partners.

AI posture: it pitches an AI powered growth engine, sells AEO and GEO through AnswerBurst, and claims AI assistants rank it the top growth partner, a claim quoted without an audited product behind it (P1 partial).

Moves: one, undated, the AnswerBurst AEO practice launch named in a blog URL. No news, case study titles, jobs or pricing model are listed. Conspicuously absent for a full service growth agency: any partner, any employee count, measurement depth beyond a BI & Analytics service (Data & Measurement scores 1), and a dated move.
clients:
The ICP is mixed and eight verticals are listed, Consumer apps, Gaming, Fintech and mortgage, Insurance, Tech and SaaS, Health and pharma, Travel and mobility and Consumer goods; the home market is the US, office New York, NY.

The needs read holds 15 clients, 12 from case studies and 3 from slugs, 11 observed and 4 names only. Organic demand leads the mix at 0.332: Microsoft Copilot grew iOS search installs across 7 markets, Uber grew organic downloads 27 percent in 90 days, Calm grew organic installs into the top 10, and Reddit grew organic app downloads 90 percent under a year alongside web build. Social and creators follows at 0.195: Samsung grew Galaxy apps downloads with social up 1400 percent, Shopkick cut CPI 87 percent through a TikTok pivot, and Miro beat signup KPI targets with influencer storytelling. Web build sits at 0.166: AIG increased car insurance leads through a website rebuild, lead generation as well, and Pfizer reached the app store top 3 in 48 hours. Upside cut cost per download, paid performance, and Redefine Meat drew waitlist signups for a European launch, brand. NewDay USA, Orlando Museum of Art, Truecaller and Bedsure are coded names only, though their slugs describe a careers site, attendance growth, branded search through influencers and in store sales.

Five clients are shared: Samsung with transmission and eskimoz, Uber with adapt-worldwide, Reddit with right-side-up, Calm with tug and Pfizer with work-co.

What the base needs next: the read places Moburst best for KJ1, the citation replacing the click, and KJ8, human provenance as a distribution signal. It is likely, moderate confidence, that these app and consumer brands next want AI assistant visibility measured as citation share and creator content with provenance marks, both sold without an audited product.
house: Say and do: five lines tested, all corroborated, integrity 100, no gap flagged. AI Search / GEO: it publishes llms.txt and 19 AI topic URLs sit in its sitemap. Paid Social: meta_pixel and linkedin_insight run on its own site. LinkedIn advertising: 6 company page ads of its own. Publishing cadence: 480 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 542 in 365, from 795 in total. Creator & Influencer: own Instagram and YouTube channels linked from the site. The tag stack shows gtm, google_ads, meta_pixel, linkedin_insight, cookiebot and cookieyes on WordPress, with no test tools and no ABM stack. No AI crawlers are blocked. Google ads: 23 in the Transparency Center, 2 in the last 30 days, all text, last shown 2026-09-25, under MOBURST LTD; one reads "Boost Clicks with GEO Services". A LinkedIn ad reads "+1400% for Samsung. +90% organic growth for Reddit. +27% for Uber. Real brands, real category leaders." Meta and TikTok: the record is silent.
market:
The Horus read scores Moburst at 12.5 on the tailwind index, Favored band, percentile 53. It is best placed for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation (net 0.243: AI Search / GEO and Content & Digital PR positive, SEO negative), and KJ8, human provenance becomes a distribution signal (net 0.225, Creator & Influencer and Content & Digital PR). It is most exposed to KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out (net -0.15, Paid Social, SEO and Content & Digital PR), and KJ5, the price of attention splits in two (net -0.113). Best scenario fit: The Commons Rebuilt at 42/100. P moves: making P4, partial on P1 and P7, unknown on P5, absent on P2, P6 and P8, not applicable on P3.

The Monsoon read: index 53.4, Breeze band, percentile 41, migration 51.9 against displacement 54.9, inferred. The verdict says SEO (10) and Web & Product (10) carry the most movable hours and the shore split sends 65% to South and Southeast Asia and 25% to Latin America; no hub office or onshore claim is listed.
openings:
No house contradiction exists, all five tests pass, so lead with proof. Moburst sells AEO and GEO through AnswerBurst and claims AI assistants rank it the top growth partner, but no audited AI visibility product (citation share, scorecard, tracking) shows in the record, P1 partial, and no feed, schema or entity work appears on its search or web lines, P2 absent. A rival leading with an audited citation number and the machine readable layer very likely, moderate confidence, wins the AEO conversation with its app brands. Falsifier: a published AI visibility scorecard or tracking product under AnswerBurst.

The contestable clients are the shared ones, Samsung (transmission, eskimoz), Uber (adapt-worldwide), Reddit (right-side-up), Calm (tug) and Pfizer (work-co), plus the four names only accounts. It is most exposed to KJ6 through Paid Social, SEO and content hours, so the media buying line is the one to price against; with no public pricing model (P5 unknown), a transparent outcome priced offer is a conversation it cannot have in public. It sells paid search at score 1 with no test of ads inside assistants (P8 absent): the first rival to show results there sets the price, low confidence on the budget it holds.
